contract_assertions.assertion: Worker ingests current analysis.result.issues[] findings, normalizes MM:SS timestamps and numeric severities, generates internal finding IDs, and persists route state plus refs/overrides.
Worker routes expose unrouted listing plus route/refs/retry/reopen/override lifecycle endpoints and return 404 for missing findings without regressing upstream Worker features.
Targeted tests cover ingest normalization, dedupe, lifecycle transitions, and missing-finding behavior.
The durable per-finding ledger schema is additive and persists lifecycle and linkage fields.
